notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hey folks! Dom T. Reviewer here! And so is 1.0.4! (Great segue, huh?) No typos this time! It's all about the soundtrack, baby!

Don't get too scared! The soundtracks's just been remastered. I've been meaning to remaster the soundtrack just to up the bit rate. It was at 160 before, which is fine and all for cartoons or YouTube videos, but 320 is closer to the standard for music. (I just wasn't thinking.) I know some of the instruments I use don't sound the greatest, but I can definitely hear a difference, so it's worth it in my book. Hopefully your high-end gaming rigs can handle the awesome power of the extra twenty-something megabytes! Wooooo!

P.S. This remastering applies to both the game and the soundtrack folder for personal use. (Remember, you can 'Browse local files' if you want to grab it.)

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey, kids! Your old pal, Dom here! Just wanted to pop in real quick to tell you all about our Lord and Savior, version 1.0.3, and note all of the changes that were made within it. (This update should be even more painless than the last.) I really do appreciate you guys submitting typos! It's not a matter of laziness, it's just a matter of me sucking at proofreading.

Changes:
*Changed "at your both and waitting" to "at your booth and waiting."
*Changed "fifteen minutes get back" to "fifteen minutes to get back."
*Changed "countless Hymens" to "countless hymens."
*Changed "Afterwords, I bet" to "Afterwards, I bet."
*Changed "Green Egg and Ham" to "Green Ham and egg."
*Changed "just a miserable" to "just as miserable."

I know that there's a way you can sell the soundtracks to games separately now, but the game soundtrack is still included in this update. Please blast it as loud as you possibly can inside your car with the bass turned all the way up, and the treble turned all the way down so people will think you're cool!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Just wanted to mention that version 1.0.2 has just been released, and note all the changes that were made. Nothing too big or crazy. Should be a pretty painless update to download.

Changes:
*Changed "friend yours" to "friend of yours."
*Changed "riggerious crossword puzzle"  to "rigorous crossword puzzle."
*Added 'Aria Dating Simulator OST' folder.

Yep, I added a folder containing the game soundtrack within the game folder! If you're a fan of the music in the game, there you go. It's a Thanksgiving miracle! (I figure it gives you a little more bang for your buck.) As always, if anyone notices any more typos, they can always bring them up and I can always make another update later on.
